heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與初入外交界
heading.en: Birth, studies and entry into the diplomatic service

body.zh-Hant: 法蘭茲一世生於1853年8月28日，卒於1938年7月25日，是阿洛伊斯二世·約瑟夫之子。他在維也納就讀 Schottengymnasium，1871至1878年在維也納與布拉格修讀法律，隨後進入奧匈帝國外交界。1878年秋，他以臨時隨員的身分被派往奧地利駐布魯塞爾公使館；1879年，他應兄長約翰二世之請不再返回布魯塞爾，轉而進入親王家產的管理，並在典禮場合代表親王。
body.en: Franz I was born on 28 August 1853 and died on 25 July 1938; he was a son of Alois II Josef. He attended the Schottengymnasium in Vienna and studied law in Vienna and Prague from 1871 to 1878, then entered the Austro-Hungarian diplomatic service. In the autumn of 1878 he was assigned as a provisional attaché to the Austrian legation in Brussels; in 1879, at the wish of his brother Prince Johann II, he did not return to Brussels but entered the administration of the princely estates and represented the prince on ceremonial occasions.

Schottengymnasium in Wien, 1871–1878 Studium der Rechtswissenschaften

heading.zh-Hant: 軍職與駐聖彼得堡大使
heading.en: Army service and the embassy in St Petersburg

body.zh-Hant: 1887年，奧匈外交部與維也納宮廷因他代表親王出席典禮而注意到他，委以出使羅馬與聖彼得堡的外交任務。1888年，他在對俄戰爭一觸即發之際自願從軍，軍階先為少尉（1888），後升中尉（1893）。1894年12月至1898年12月，他任奧匈帝國駐聖彼得堡大使；1897年的皇帝會晤（Kaiser-Entrevue）是其外交生涯的高峰，他在奧匈代表團離開後以口頭談成十年期的協約。他主張與沙俄結盟，在維也納遭遇阻力，終致被迫辭職。
body.en: In 1887 the Austro-Hungarian foreign ministry and the Viennese court took notice of him and entrusted him with diplomatic missions to Rome and St Petersburg. In 1888, when war with Russia threatened, he volunteered for the army, where he was a lieutenant (1888) and later a first lieutenant (1893). From December 1894 to December 1898 he was the Austro-Hungarian ambassador in St Petersburg; the high point of his diplomatic career was the Emperors' meeting of 1897, when he negotiated a ten-year entente orally after the Austro-Hungarian delegation had left. He sought an alliance with Russia, met resistance in Vienna, and this led to his involuntary resignation.

citations.quote: Letzteres lenkte 1887 das Interesse des österreichisch-ungarischen

heading.zh-Hant: 學術贊助、戰時與貴族院
heading.en: Patronage, the war years and the Herrenhaus

body.zh-Hant: 1899年自聖彼得堡返回後，他協助兄長約翰二世充實親王畫廊，並贊助藝術與科學；1907年，他大力促成維也納大學設立東歐史講座與研討班。1904至1914年，他代表親王參與瓦杜茲城堡的重建委員會。1914年獲選為維也納科學院名譽院士。一戰期間他率領馬爾他騎士團（Malteser）的醫療列車；1916年，他阻止了埃茨貝格爾把列支敦斯登交給教廷作為教皇國的計畫；1917年5月19日，他成為奧地利貴族院的世襲議員。1918年帝國崩潰後，他支援末代皇帝卡爾流亡的家人。
body.en: After returning from St Petersburg in 1899 he advised his brother Johann II on furnishing the princely picture gallery and promoted art and scholarship; in 1907 he was instrumental in creating a chair and seminar for East European history at the University of Vienna. From 1904 to 1914 he represented the prince on the commission for rebuilding Vaduz Castle. In 1914 he became an honorary member of the Academy of Sciences in Vienna. In the First World War he led a Maltese hospital train; in 1916 he prevented Matthias Erzberger's plan to hand Liechtenstein to the Holy See as a papal state; on 19 May 1917 he became a hereditary member of the Austrian Herrenhaus. After the collapse of the empire in 1918 he supported the family of the last emperor, Charles, in exile.

citations.quote: Nach seiner Rückkehr aus St. Petersburg 1899 beriet Franz I. seinen Bruder

body.zh-Hant: 自1921年起，他又擔任親王在外交事務上的代理人。他早在繼位之前，就對列支敦斯登一戰後的重新定位有重大影響，此一定位帶來新憲法，以及與瑞士緊密的經濟結合。1929年2月11日約翰二世去世後，76歲的他以法蘭茲一世之名成為在位親王。此後他才得以與艾爾莎·埃羅什·馮·貝特倫法爾瓦結婚，因為約翰二世不允許這段婚姻。
body.en: From 1921 he was also the prince's deputy in foreign policy. Long before his accession he had considerable influence on the reorientation of Liechtenstein after 1918, which led to a new constitution and a close economic link with Switzerland. After the death of Johann II on 11 February 1929 he became reigning prince, as Franz I, at the age of 76. Only then could he marry Elsa Erős von Bethlenfalva, since Johann II had not permitted the marriage.

citations.quote: Ab 1921 war er zudem Stellvertreter des Fürsten in der Aussenpolitik.
Franz I. hatte schon lange vor seinem Regierungsantritt massgeblichen
Neuorientierung des Landes nach 1918, welche zu einer neuen Verfassung
und zur engen wirtschaftlicher Verbindung mit der Schweiz führte
Nach dem Tod Johanns II. am 11.2.1929 wurde er als Franz I. mit 76 Jahren
mit 76 Jahren Landesfürst
Erst jetzt konnte er Elsa Erős von Bethlenfalva heiraten.
Denn Fürst Johann II. hatte die Ehe mit Elsa
ungleichen Stands war, nicht erlaubt

body.zh-Hant: 1929年3月13日在邦議會、同年8月11日在瓦杜茲的城堡草地，分別舉行了效忠儀式；同年他與夫人創立「弗蘭茨親王暨艾爾莎親王妃基金會」。在位的1929至1938年間，他讓約瑟夫·霍普領導的政府有相當自由的施政空間，對邦議會通過的每部法律都予批准。1935年起，疾病與年老使他不再訪問列支敦斯登。他是最後一位從維也納、塔爾霍夫、費爾茨貝格或艾斯格魯布治理領地的親王，1938年7月25日在費爾茨貝格去世。
body.en: The oath of homage took place in the Landtag on 13 March 1929 and on the castle meadow in Vaduz on 11 August 1929; in the same year he and his wife founded the Prince Franz and Princess Elsa Foundation. During his reign of 1929–1938 he left the government under Josef Hoop considerable freedom and approved every law passed by the Landtag. From 1935 illness and frailty prevented further visits to Liechtenstein. He was the last prince to rule his country from Vienna, Thalhof, Feldsberg or Eisgrub, and he died at Feldsberg on 25 July 1938.

people.name: José María Orellana Pinto
people.nameZh: 何塞·瑪麗亞·奧雷利亞納

body.zh-Hant: 美國國會圖書館人名權威檔登錄何塞·瑪麗亞·奧雷利亞納（José María Orellana）的生卒年為1872年與1926年。1921年12月6日，美國駐瓜地馬拉公使麥克米林（McMillin）電告國務卿：一場軍事革命自午夜持續到清晨五時，推翻了埃雷拉（Herrera）政府；奧雷利亞納、利馬（Lima）與拉拉韋（Larrave）三位將軍領導一個臨時政府。總統埃雷拉被軟禁在自宅，全體閣員被關進軍事監獄，警方的抵抗造成約十二人死亡，市區平靜。
body.en: The Library of Congress name authority record gives the years of José María Orellana as 1872 to 1926. On 6 December 1921 the US Minister in Guatemala, McMillin, telegraphed the Secretary of State that an army revolution, running from midnight until five in the morning, had overthrown the Herrera government; Generals Orellana, Lima and Larrave headed a provisional government. President Herrera was a prisoner in his home, his whole cabinet was in military prison, about a dozen people were killed by police resistance, and the city was quiet.

citations.quote: Orellana, José María, 1872-1926
The Minister in Guatemala ( McMillin ) to the Secretary of State
Guatemala , December 6, 1921—9 a.m.
A revolution through the Army began at midnight ending five this
morning overthrowing Herrera government.
Generals Orellana, Lima, and Larrave head a provisional government.
President Herrera prisoner in his home.
All his Cabinet in military prison.
About a dozen killed by police resistance.
City quiet.

heading.en: January 1922: calling elections and the party nomination

body.zh-Hant: 1922年1月12日，美國代辦柯蒂斯（Curtis）電告國務卿：議會當天下午對一項決議做了三次逐日朗讀中的第一次，宣告「聯盟」（Union）不復存在、瓜地馬拉重為獨立共和國；奧雷利亞納將軍同日頒布命令，定於2月15日至22日舉行選舉。1月22日，柯蒂斯再電告：自由黨的大會當天下午提名奧雷利亞納；電報的註腳另記烏維科（Ubico）將軍也曾是該提名的候選人。
body.en: On 12 January 1922 the US Chargé, Curtis, telegraphed the Secretary of State that the Assembly that afternoon had given the first of three daily readings to a resolution declaring the Union non-existent and Guatemala again an independent republic; General Orellana that day issued a decree calling elections for 15 to 22 February. On 22 January Curtis reported that the convention of the Liberal Party that afternoon had nominated Orellana; a footnote adds that General Ubico had also been a candidate for the nomination.

citations.quote: The Chargé in Guatemala ( Curtis ) to the Secretary of State
Guatemala , January 12, 1922—9 p.m.
The Assembly this afternoon gave first of three daily readings to a resolution
declaring the Union non-existent and Guatemala again an independent republic.
General Orellana today issued a decree calling the elections for February
15th to 22nd.
Guatemala , January 22, 1922—10 p.m.
Convention of the Liberal Party this afternoon nominated Orellana.
General Ubico, also, had been a candidate for the nomination.

body.zh-Hant: 1922年3月4日中午，美國代辦索思蓋特（Southgate）電告國務卿：奧雷利亞納當天上午就任共和國總統，其就職演說強調政治和平與勤奮工作的必要。
body.en: On 4 March 1922, at noon, the US Chargé, Southgate, telegraphed the Secretary of State that the inauguration of Orellana as President of the Republic had taken place that morning, and that his address emphasised the necessity of political peace and hard work.

body.zh-Hant: 1922年8月1日，美國公使蓋斯勒（Geissler）電告，瓜地馬拉總統對一場針對宏都拉斯政府的革命運動表達嚴重關切；奧雷利亞納說他掌握可靠消息，其目的是在宏都拉斯建立一個保守、親墨西哥的政府。8月18日，蓋斯勒電告，他前一天拜會了奧雷利亞納總統，後者表示瓜地馬拉政府沒有也不會干涉鄰國的內政，並且不想參加三位中美洲總統的會議；蓋斯勒認為他在不介入各國爭端上態度十分誠懇。
body.en: On 1 August 1922 the US Minister, Geissler, reported that the President of Guatemala expressed very grave concern over a revolutionary movement against the Honduran government; Orellana said he had reliable information that its purpose was to install a conservative, pro-Mexican government in Honduras. On 18 August Geissler reported that he had called on President Orellana the previous day; Orellana stated that the Guatemalan government had not intervened and would not intervene in the domestic affairs of neighbouring countries and had no desire to join the conference of the three Central American Presidents; Geissler found him absolutely sincere in wishing to stay out of the controversies.

body.zh-Hant: 克努森生於1848年9月19日，是挪威的船東與政治人物，屬自由黨（Venstre）。他的政治生涯始於1886年，當年獲選為耶爾彭（Gjerpen）的鎮長。1901至1903年，他是自由黨的斯廷（Johannes Steen）與布勒（Otto Blehr）兩屆政府的成員，先在斯德哥爾摩的國務院部門服務，後來任農業部長，再任財政部長。1905年3月，他在米凱爾森（Christian Michelsen）的聯合政府出任財政大臣；同年10月，因身為共和派反對選丹麥的卡爾親王為國王而辭職。
body.en: Knudsen was born on 19 September 1848, a Norwegian shipowner and politician for the Liberal party Venstre. His political career began in 1886, when he was elected mayor of Gjerpen. From 1901 to 1903 he was a member of the Venstre governments of Johannes Steen and Otto Blehr, serving first in the Council of State department in Stockholm and later as minister of agriculture and then of finance. In March 1905 he became finance minister in Christian Michelsen's coalition government; in October of that year he resigned, having opposed as a republican the election of Prince Carl of Denmark as king.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年1月自由黨「鞏固」之後，克努森主導解散議會自由黨協會，另組新協會並由自己出任主席。1908年3月18日，他以首相兼財政大臣的身分重返政府；該屆政府從3月19日任職到1910年2月2日，是倚賴議會逐案支持的少數政府。1909年，國家開辦公共疾病保險。同年卡爾·貝爾納（Carl Berner）卸任自由黨主席，由克努森接任，任至1927年。1909年的選舉由右派與新的自由思想自由黨勝出，他的政府隨之下台，由科諾夫（Wollert Konow）內閣接替。
body.en: After the Venstre 'consolidation' of January 1908 Knudsen had the parliamentary Venstre association dissolved and a new one formed with himself as chairman. On 18 March 1908 he returned to government as prime minister and finance minister; the government sat from 19 March 1908 to 2 February 1910 and was a minority government dependent on case-by-case support in the Storting. In 1909 public health insurance was introduced. In the same year Carl Berner stepped down as Venstre chairman and was succeeded by Knudsen, who held the post until 1927. The 1909 election was a victory for the Conservatives and the new Free-minded Liberals, his government fell as a result and was replaced by Wollert Konow's ministry.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年的選舉中，自由黨取得其歷來最大的勝利之一，在123席中拿下70席而掌握絕對多數；克努森本人在兩個月內發表了65場演說。他於1913年1月底組成第二屆政府，並在1913至1918年兼任農業與審計部首長。第一次世界大戰爆發時，他同情英國，但支持外交大臣伊倫（Nils Claus Ihlen）的中立路線。自由黨在1918年的選舉失利，絕對多數就此結束。1920年6月，他為「公路百萬」（vegmillionen）一案提出內閣信任問題，政府於1920年6月21日下台。
body.en: In the 1912 election Venstre won one of its greatest victories, taking 70 of 123 seats and a clear majority; Knudsen himself gave 65 speeches in two months. He formed his second government at the end of January 1913 and in 1913–1918 was also head of the Ministry of Agriculture and Auditing. When the First World War broke out he sympathised with Britain but supported the neutrality line of Foreign Minister Nils Claus Ihlen. Venstre lost the 1918 election and its majority position ended. In June 1920 he made the 'road million' a question of confidence, and the government resigned on 21 June 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 下台後，克努森在議會擔任議長直到會期結束，但此後婉拒再度參選。1921年哈爾沃森（Otto Bahr Halvorsen）的政府下台時，有人請他出任首相，他拒絕了。他仍擔任自由黨主席直到1927年，並在黨內保持很大的影響力。1928年12月1日，他在斯基恩（Skien）的博格斯塔德（Borgestad）去世。
body.en: After leaving office Knudsen was President of the Storting until the end of the session, but then declined to stand for election. When Otto Bahr Halvorsen's government fell in 1921 he was asked to become prime minister but said no. He remained chairman of Venstre until 1927 and kept great influence in the party. He died on 1 December 1928 at Borgestad in Skien.
